description: R-SQL-1 SQL-B: Which identifier forms bind for a table and fields named with a space and a reserved word: bracketed, unbracketed reserved word, an alias containing an escaped bracket ([x]]y]), backtick quoting, and a bracketed qualified name? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-accdb-main opened read-only through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
